name: dsh-plugin-design-forge
description: DeepSeek Harness design library: design_capture scrapes a website's real design (palette, typography scale, spacing, radii, shadows, gradients, CSS custom-property tokens) into a persistent local library, design_library lists/searches/exports it as ready-to-paste tokens.css or a design spec, and a system-prompt section makes agents check the library first whenever they build websites, app UIs, or document layouts.
